shapes.rules: One or two representative inputs. Assert the exact return value, never its type or its length.
Empty input, one element, and the value either side of each limit. One test per boundary, exact values.

functions.name: unique
functions.notes: First occurrence wins and order is preserved. SameValueZero, so NaN counts as equal to NaN here.

functions.name: zip
functions.signature: zip<A, B>(as: readonly A[], bs: readonly B[]): Array<[A, B]>
functions.notes: Stops at the shorter input; the extra elements of the longer one are dropped, not padded.

functions.name: rotate
functions.signature: rotate<T>(xs: readonly T[], by: number): T[]
functions.notes: Left by `by`, and negative rotates right. `by` is taken modulo the length, so a rotation larger than the array wraps.

functions.name: takeWhile
functions.signature: takeWhile<T>(xs: readonly T[], predicate: (item: T, index: number) => boolean): T[]
functions.notes: The leading run only: it stops at the first failure and never looks past it. The predicate receives the index.
